wikipedia.pt: Frente Nacional de Libertação de Angola

names: Frente Nacional de Libertação de Angola
National Front for the Liberation of Angola
summary: The northern Angolan movement, formed in 1962 out of the UPA and the PDA and operating largely from what was then the Congo; a signatory of the Alvor Agreement and a loser of the war that followed it.
